description: R7-INFRA-4 baseline: documents that --apply-fixes damages. Each entry is a KNOWN defect awaiting the R7-3 fixer guard. The gate fails on a NEW breakage and on an unrecorded improvement, so this list can only shrink.

properties.c_verdict_non_degrading: a READY document must not become NOT-READY
properties.b_oracle_class_preserving: a document that compiled must still compile

oracle.note: Mirrors corpora/false_ready/manifest.json's oracle block, which tex-oracle.yml pin-asserts. This corpus had pdflatex_graded=true and NOTHING ELSE: no engine, no version, no protocol, and nothing asserting any of them. A TeX Live upgrade would silently change what property (b) means for these rows and no gate would notice. Recorded now because it is VERIFIED rather than assumed: the first CI run of property (b) against the pinned image (tex-oracle run 30834930925) reproduced this baseline exactly — 72 documents x 4 cells, the same 5 known_broken rows, PASS.
